explication: agent-desktop is a cross-platform desktop automation CLI and C library. Its principal loop is: an agent requests an accessibility snapshot, receives snapshot-scoped element refs, issues an action using a ref, then snapshots again to verify. The graph also preserves documented command families, session/batch features, native platform adapters, and the FFI. Some subsystem paths are directories because their implementations span many files; unsampled internals and links are not asserted beyond the README or indexed references.
